about: Shared U6 product policy vectors. TypeScript (packages/core product-policy-vectors.test.ts) and Swift (StillKit ProductPolicyVectorTests) must give exactly these verdicts. When present, padTo appends ASCII spaces to body until it is that many UTF-8 bytes. Expectations are hand-authored, never generated from either implementation.
